Name: Inheritance
Author: Bengesko
Description:
[center][u][size=5][b]Inheritance[/b][/size][/u]

Everyone talked about how the farm you inherited had once been a pillar of the community, that Grandpa had loved it with all his heart.

So what happened to the farm? What happened to everything that came with it? And why, despite everyone in Pelican Town saying they had loved the farm, did it fall into such disrepair?

Grandpa was a bit more shrewd than everyone knew.... as you'll discover, the more work you put into the restoration of your farm. [/center]

[center]
----------------[/center]


[b][size=4][u]What this is:[/u][/size]
[/b][list]
[*]A "lore friendly" boost for new games without using cheat mods.
[*]The "inheritance" is 10,000.
[*]The letter will show up in your mail on Spring 1, Year 1.
[*]It will also show up in established saves!
[*]Advance your farm, and be rewarded by your eccentric grandfather.
[/list][b][color=#c27ba0][size=4][u]
[color=#ffffff]Installation:[/color][/u][/size][/color]
[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Download and Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b]

[*][b]Download and Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿ to /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/b]

[*][b]Download and Install this mod to /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/b]
[/list]
[b]Change Log:[/b]


[list]
[*]v1.1.1 - fixed broken dependency lines.
[*]v1.1.0 - updated manifest to work properly with MFM's framework.
[/list][list]
[*]v1.2.0 - updated manifest.
[*]v1.3.0 - updated manifest to work properly with MFM's updated framework; increased the amount given to 10,000.
[*]v1.4.0 - added new rewards for expanding the farmhouse.
[*]v1.5.0 - updated manifest; updated some lines in the letters; increased prismatic shard rewards to 3, up from 1. 
[/list]
[color=#e06666][size=4][u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]This mod requires Mail Framework Mod, and as such, is not compatible with FeTk and ﻿Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service
[/list]
[b]Want to tweak the amount? Want to get an estate's worth of money? A pittance? [/b]

[list]
[*]You can go into the "Mail" file in the mod's folder, and edit the following line:
[/list]
[quote]??%item money 10000 10001 %%",[/quote][list]
[*]Change the numbers to whatever amount you want- example: 20000 20001, to give yourself 20,000 instead of 10,000!
[/list]
[size=3][b][u]Future Planned Updates:
[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Seasonal letters
[*]Story based letters (eg: finding another letter with every house upgrade; finding letters when upgrading/fixing parts of the Community Center.)
[*]Milestone Year reward letters (Year 3, 5, 10)
[*]More story related content
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]Disclaimer: [/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*]This is [b]not [/b]a diss on anyone who uses cheats like CJB-[b][i] I use them all the time.[/i][/b]
[*]This is simply a mod to give a lore friendly boost for "challenge playthroughs,"  or folks who don't use CJB.
[*]I made this for myself for one of my "no CJB" runs and thought I'd share it here. ♥
[*][i][size=2]This is my first mod, please be gentle, lol. [/size][/i]
[/list]
[u][b][size=4]Mods in screenshot:[/size][/b][/u]
[list]

[/list]
